name: bluShift Aerospace
tagline: Fixing the Pentagon’s rocket motor bottleneck
description: bluShift Aerospace is developing bio-derived, carbon-neutral rocket fuels and modular launch vehicles for the small satellite market. The company successfully launched the first commercial rocket powered by bio-derived fuel in 2021 and has conducted over 275 engine tests. Their technology aims to provide frequent, affordable, and earth-friendly launch services from coastal Maine.

founders.name: Sascha Deri
founders.bio: Sascha co-founded one of the first online solar distribution and light-manufacturing companies, growing it to more than $35M in sales. In 2014, he founded bluShift to reduce the cost and wait time of launch services.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: bluShift has surpassed $600k in current funding to address the Pentagon's rocket motor bottleneck.

highlights: Flight-proven technology with successful commercial launch
Over 275 successful engine tests to date

name: VAWAA
tagline: Mini-apprenticeships with master artists in their studios, worldwide.
description: VAWAA is a curated marketplace for immersive learning experiences with world-class artists and makers across 65+ countries. The platform enables travelers to book 3-7 day private apprenticeships in various creative disciplines, from calligraphy in Japan to ceramics in Slovenia. VAWAA is building a new category of creative travel centered on skill-sharing and human connection.

founders.name: Geetika Agrawal
founders.bio: 20 years experience across design and technology at R/GA and Disney Imagineering. Built VAWAA after learning from artists in 65+ countries. TEDIndia speaker.

updates.title: 50% Organic Growth
updates.body: VAWAA achieved over 50% year-over-year organic growth in 2024 without paid marketing spend.

highlights: Network of master artists in 65+ countries
Founder is a former Disney Imagineer and TED speaker

name: HEVO
tagline: Wireless charging infrastructure to power our EV future
description: HEVO provides wireless charging networks for electric vehicles, focusing on commercial, municipal, and military fleets. Their technology eliminates the need for physical plug-in stations, reducing operational hazards and infrastructure wear. Through partnerships with global automakers like Stellantis, HEVO is standardizing wireless power transfer for the next generation of EVs.

founders.name: Jeremy McCool
founders.bio: US Army combat veteran and Columbia SIPA grad. Under his leadership, HEVO achieved UL and SAE certifications and secured agreements with major automakers.

updates.title: Stellantis Partnership
updates.body: Continued development of wireless charging products for integration into Stellantis' global EV lineup.

highlights: UL and SAE certified wireless charging technology

name: Emission Free Generators
description: Emission Free Generators develops portable, zero-emission power solutions using patented hydrogen-on-demand technology. Their generators provide a clean alternative to gasoline units for recreation, retail, and outdoor lifestyles without requiring high-pressure hydrogen storage. The leadership team holds 28 patents and brings executive experience from Toyota and Nestlé.

founders.name: Mark Collins
founders.bio: Inventor with 28 patents across mechanical and electrical disciplines. 35 years of commercialization experience with 3 successful exits.

updates.title: Patent Portfolio Expansion
updates.body: Leveraging 28 patents to finalize the commercial prototype of the hydrogen-on-demand system.

highlights: Leadership team with 28 patents and 3 exits
Targeting the growing outdoor and portable power market

name: Azure Printed Homes
description: Azure Printed Homes uses large-scale 3D printing and recycled plastics to create sustainable backyard studios and accessory dwelling units (ADUs). Their automated construction process reduces build times by 70% and costs by 30% compared to traditional methods. With millions in annual revenue and a significant pre-order backlog, Azure is scaling to meet the demand for affordable housing.

founders.name: Ross Maguire
founders.bio: Civil Engineer with 13 years of experience in construction and design. Previously founded and led a residential construction firm in London for 8 years.

updates.title: Revenue Milestone
updates.body: Azure reported over $7M in annual revenue for the previous fiscal year with $30M in pre-orders.

highlights: Construction process 70% faster than traditional building
